claim_summary: Operator-conducted ARIA cross-check (2026-05-10) of 1086 raw findings produced by 13 SHADOW adapters in cycle cyc-20260510T0156Z surfaced four classes of adapter calibration blockers preventing SHADOW->ACTIVE promotion. Anchor 1: cqrs-adapter + outbox-adapter + agent-harness-security-adapter all emit findings with status=invalid_evidence (evidence_validator chain still has SELF_OUTPUT or canonical-resolve gap; F-005 anchor #13 partially closed by commit c16ffc18 but not fully). Anchor 2: schema-drift-adapter and typeorm-entity-schema-adapter produce IDENTICAL 75-row findings (5130+1199 raw_observations vs 75+75 raw_findings; same migration_registry_missing_entry rule), indicating shared parser or duplicate-pipeline architecture (F-003 sub-anchor); operator cross-check reduced apparent 75 to 5 unique unregistered migrations + 1 false positive .spec.ts (Phase B escalation). Anchor 3: test-gap-adapter heuristic only checks adjacent-or-importing test signal, missing behavior-equivalent integration tests in e2e/tests/integration/* (e.g. e2e/tests/integration/audit-immutability.spec.ts present but AuditLogImmutability migration flagged as testless). Anchor 4: security-boundary-adapter rejects @Public()+@ThrottlePasswordReset() decorator combination as insufficient explicit-allowlist marker, generating noise on legitimate public endpoints (e.g. apps/admin-api-service/src/auth/password-reset.controller.ts forgotPassword + resetPassword).

interpretations.text: Anchors 1+2 block adapter promotion to ACTIVE. Anchors 3+4 are calibration concerns; can be deferred to next Plan iteration without blocking promotion.
Anchor 1 is a continuation of F-005 anchor #13; partial closure (commit c16ffc18) did not cover all evidence_validator paths (cqrs/outbox/agent-harness still affected).
Anchor 2 may be intentional architectural redundancy (defense-in-depth) rather than duplicate work; data-expert review needed before consolidation.

recommendation: Anchors 1+2 must close before any adapter promotion. Recommended sequence: (a) extend F-005 anchor #13 fix to cover remaining evidence_validator paths; verify with a re-run that cqrs/outbox/agent-harness emit valid evidence. (b) Consolidate schema-drift + typeorm-entity-schema (one adapter as primary, the other deprecated; route via shared parser module). (c) For anchor 3, extend test-gap heuristic to scan e2e/integration test contents for migration class names + SQL DDL signatures, plus exclude .spec.ts files from migration_registry_missing_entry candidate list (DEBT-2026-05-10-002 tracks heuristic widening). (d) For anchor 4, relax security-boundary rule to accept @Public() + rate-limit decorator combination (preferred), OR add explicit '// public-write-allowlist:' comment convention to repo (operator decision).
